title: 宝塚記念の後に・燃やす

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City gives it her all and wins the Takarazuka Kinen against Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Tamamo Cross reveals she had originally been looking forward to facing Gold City, having been inspired by her fiery determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But by the time the opportunity came, Gold City had found herself in a slump, leaving Tamamo Cross frustrated to see her rival so affected by public opinion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, however, Gold City's real fighting spirit has returned. When she explains that she runs for the sake of running itself, Tamamo Cross is finally satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking forward, Gold City seeks a more grueling challenge. She decides to run in the Japan Cup, where the "Beast" Oguri Cap awaits.
